༄༅/ /ḍā ki singha mu kha'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ḍā ki singha mu kha'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so//

seng gdong ma'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang la/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma/ a las zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang ro'i gdan la rang nyid skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sku mdog mthing nag seng ge'i zhal dkar po gdangs shing spyan gsum bsgrad pa/ thod skam lnga rin po che'i rtse bran bcas 'chang zhing ral pa sngo skya gyen du 'phyo ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa'i mchan khung du tri shū la bsgrengs pa/ zhing chen dang glang lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs grol ba/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ nu ma 'phyang zhing rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥ hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du gyur pa las rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ oṃ ḍā ki nī singha mu kha sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapad pra tītstsha swā hā/ hrīḥ ma tshogs mkha' 'gro kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// gdong lnga'i stobs kyis phrin las kun sgrub cing*// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das kun gyi bdag /za byed chen mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod la bsgom// sngags bzla ba ni/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing gi mthar yi ge bcu bzhi pa 'od 'bar ba g.yas su bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs dang bla ma yi dam chos skyong thams cad kyi byin rlabs mthu stobs thams cad bsdus te thugs ka'i sa bon la stim zhing dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod pa'i phrin las 'grub par dmigs/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ci nus bzlas/ thun mthar/

khro mo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drongs// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod// ces brjod/ dus kun tu lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral bar bya'o// zhes pa'ang ma byan gtsang chung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas bris/// / ༈ /singha mu kha'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo bzhugs so// zla tshes gang yang rung ba'i/ tshes brgyad/ bcu/ bco lnga/ nyer lnga/ nyer dgu/ gnam gang la sogs la mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can gyi tshogs kyi 'khor los mnyes par byed na/ seng gdong ma'i rten gyi mdun du/ gtor ma sman raka mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ tshogs rdzas sha zan chang bza' btung g.yos sbyar gyi rigs sna tshogs pa 'du bya/ rang nyid seng gdong ma'i bdag bskyed byas te/ bsnyen pa ci 'grub byas rjes/ mdun gyi rten bris 'bur gang yin seng gdong ma dngos su bsam/ tshogs rdzas stan gyi steng rang nyid kyi mdun du/ dbus su chang*/ g.yas su sha zan/ g.yon du g.yos sbyar rnams me rlung chus sbyangs zhing*/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum brjod/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las ka pā la phyi dkar nang dmar ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du dbus su mi/ shar du ba lang*/ lhor rta/ nub tu khyi/ byang du glang po che'i sha rnams kyi steng gi dbus su dri chu/ shar lhor dri chen/ lho nub tu rakta/ nub byang du byang sems/ byang shar du go ro tsa na rnams/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ māṃ lāṃ bāṃ pāṃ tāṃ rnams kyis mtshan pa'i kha chod zla ba ā di kā dis mtshan pas bcad pa/ yaṃ las rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bas nyes pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ zla ba dbyangs gsal dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ ā hūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum brjod/ tshogs dang po gtor ma'i rten la 'bul/ sman raka sgron la/ hūm̐ */ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas// rtsa brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol// rang bzhin dbyings kyi pho brang nas// seng ge'i gdong can la sogs pa'i// mkha' 'gro dpa' bo gshegs su gsol// dag pa phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas// dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol// 'dir bzhugs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol| |gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī singha mu kha sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hiḥ zhes 'bul/ gnyis pa 'bul zhing*/ hoḥ bdag gzhan ma rig 'khrul pa'i blos// bskyed rim ma gsal sngags ma dag |ting 'dzin g.yel zhing mchod gtor nyams/ /nongs gyur gang yin bzod par bzhes/ /tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags/ /tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol| |yig brgya brjod/ tshogs tha ma ni/ zan ling ngam sha zan dmigs bya dgug gzhug bya/ hūm̐ */ nga ni singha mu kha ste// khros pa'i thugs srog 'phro 'du las// las kyi ma mo skar ltar spros// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// dril bu thogs pa'i las byed kyis// dgra bgegs dgug gzhug bcing ba dang*// myos shing gzugs la dbab par byas// thun mtshon nad dug char phab cing*| |rdo rje mtshon cha'i tshogs kyis bsad// rnam shes yum gyi dbyings su bstim// aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ gnod byed dgra bgegs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sha trūṃ mā ra ya hur thuṃ rbad sod/ ces bsgral/ gtor mar bstab cing sman raka bran la/ hoḥ za byed 'bar ba seng ge'i gdong*// 'phrog byed chen mo 'jigs pa'i sku// mkha' 'gro grangs med 'khor gyis bskor/ lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs 'di// bsgral ba'i longs spyod mchod par 'bul// chim chim rol cing sha la zo//

cib cib rol cing khrag la 'thungs// khruṃ khruṃ rol cing rus pa mur/ khā hi khā hi kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes dang*/ ḍā ki singha mu kha sa pa ri wā ra ma hā maṃ sa rakta keṃ ni ri ti go ro tsa na ba su ta bo dhi tsitta la kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes bstab/ tshogs la longs spyod/ lhag ma bsdus par sman raka bran la/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin brlabs nas/ hoḥ sngags dang zhing las skyes la sogs// 'jig rten 'das kyang ma 'das pa'i// tshul 'dzin 'jig rten ma mo'i tshogs// lhag ma'i pha 'bab 'di la rol// rnal 'byor bar chad zhi ba dang*// bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod| |ḍā ki nī u tstshiṣṭa ba ling bhakṣa bhyaḥswā hā/ zhes gtsang sar 'bul/ gtor ma gtsang sar 'bul zhing las mjug bsdu ba sogs dkyus ltar bya'o// mkha' 'gro ma singha mu kha'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdor bsdus 'di'ang*/ ma byan gtsang chung gi thugs dam du/ sngags pa chos kyi grags pas bris pa yin no// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
